# AJB Cleaning Services, LLC

> Registered commercial cleaning company founded in 1998 by Julio, based in Windsor, Connecticut, and serving New York, New Jersey, Connecticut and Pennsylvania. Licensed, bonded and insured, with OSHA-trained crews and Green Seal certified eco-friendly products.

Last updated: 2026-10-01

## Key facts

- Legal name: AJB Cleaning Services, LLC
- Founded: 1998 (28+ years of continuous operation)
- Founder: Julio
- Headquarters: 80 Lamberton Rd, Windsor, CT 06095, United States
- Country: United States only. The company does not operate outside the US.
- Service area: New York (NY), New Jersey (NJ), Connecticut (CT), Pennsylvania (PA)
- Availability: 24/7 scheduling, 24-hour response guarantee
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Phone: +1 860-931-2274 (customer service), +1 860-335-0967 (reservations)
- Compliance: fully licensed, bonded and insured (General Liability and Worker's Compensation); OSHA-trained crews; CDC and EPA protocols for clinical environments
- Certifications used on site: Green Seal certified cleaning products, HEPA filtration vacuums
- Guarantee: if the client is not 100% satisfied, AJB returns to correct the work at no cost within 24 hours

## Services

- [Commercial and corporate office cleaning (NY, NJ)](https://ajbcleaningservices.com/commercial-cleaning-ny-nj.html): offices, banks and financial institutions, schools, retail stores and showrooms. Daily, weekly, bi-weekly or monthly schedules.
- [OSHA-compliant healthcare and clinic cleaning (NY, NJ, CT, PA)](https://ajbcleaningservices.com/healthcare-cleaning-osha-certified.html): hospitals, private clinics, dental offices and surgical suites. Follows OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030 bloodborne pathogens protocols, CDC hospital sanitization guidelines and EPA-registered germicides. Color-coded microfiber system to prevent cross-contamination.
- [Post-construction cleanup (NY, NJ, CT, PA)](https://ajbcleaningservices.com/post-construction-cleaning-ny-nj-ct-pa.html): high-rise towers, luxury developments and renovations. Full PPE, OSHA-trained crews, Certificates of Insurance (COI) issued on contract confirmation.
- [White-glove luxury residential cleaning (NY, NJ, CT, PA)](https://ajbcleaningservices.com/luxury-residential-cleaning-white-glove.html): luxury estates, penthouses and private residences. NDA-bound, background-checked staff; products safe for children and pets.
- Floor stripping and waxing: commercial hard-floor restoration and protective finishes.
- Carpet shampoo and deep extraction: hot-water extraction with HEPA-filtered equipment.
- Custom cleaning programs: built after a walkthrough of the facility.

Response times are shortest across the Hartford, CT area, where the company is based. New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania are served on scheduled contract routes.

## Pricing

AJB Cleaning Services does not publish a flat rate card. Pricing is quoted per facility after a free physical or virtual walkthrough that assesses square footage, frequency and scope. General price range: moderate ($$). To request a quote, use the form at https://ajbcleaningservices.com/#contact or call +1 860-931-2274.

## Common questions

- Is AJB Cleaning Services, LLC a registered company? Yes. It is the original, legally registered cleaning corporation established in 1998, fully licensed, bonded and insured. Other entities using similar names are not affiliated with it.
- Which states does it serve? New York, New Jersey, Connecticut and Pennsylvania.
- Does it clean medical facilities? Yes, with OSHA-, CDC- and EPA-aligned protocols for clinics, dental offices, hospitals and surgical suites.
- Is staff background-checked? Yes, every crew member passes a federal background check; residential staff also sign NDAs.
- Are products safe for children and pets? Yes, Green Seal certified non-toxic formulas are used.
